correctness.rationale: In characteristic two (I+X)²=I+X² and the first superdiagonal vanishes. In the proof's coordinates the six target equations are (ab,bc,cd,af+ec,bg₀+fd,ai+eg₀+hd), with j free. For a,d nonzero, b=A/a and c=C₀/d force B=AC₀/(ad). Unless b=c=0 the (D,E) system has rank two, and the F equation in h,i is independent, giving q³ completions per allowed a,d. If b=c=0 then (D,E)=f(a,d), with (q−1)² allowed a,d at D=E=0, q−1 when DE≠0, and none when exactly one vanishes; there are q⁴ completions per pair. For a≠0,d=0, when A≠0 the variables b,c are fixed for each a and the (D,E) system and F leave q³ completions. When A=0, B=E=0 and c,e,g₀,h,j are free, giving q⁵ per a. Reversal gives the two symmetric rows. For a=d=0 the target M is the outer product (b,e)ᵀ(c,g₀); it has q−1 factorizations at rank one, 2q²−1 at zero, and none at rank two, with four additional free variables. These input cases are disjoint, so contributions add. The four image alternatives have cardinalities (q−1)³q³, 2(q−1)q⁴, (q−1)q², q³; the identity contributions sum to q⁴[(q−1)²+2q(q−1)+2q²−1]. These give the stated polynomials. Every transvection I+sE_ij of distance at least two is a square via X=sE_{i,i+1}+E_{i+1,j}; they generate the subgroup in question. The UT₃ and UT₄ equations are surjective onto that subgroup, while the displayed B=F=1 with A=C₀=D=E=0 violates BF=DE at n=5.
residual_risks: The F₂ and F₄ outputs are recorded finite tests; all-q correctness comes from the field-independent case count. The zero fiber includes the identity itself.

originality.rationale: The current indexed corpus contains a distinct, demonstrably equivalent complete all-q square-root function, as well as a separate exact square-image result. The equivalent function is given in disjoint target cases rather than additive input strata. That difference in presentation does not change any fiber cardinality. Its catalogue key is later than that of the frozen result, so the demonstrated coverage does not establish that the overlapping result came first or that the frozen result was derived from it. The comparison is about equivalent indexed coverage at review, not priority.
residual_risks: The relationship and chronology of the two distinct complete-fiber records are unresolved. Different date keys do not establish priority. A broad literature lookup did not yield decisive additional evidence; the verdict rests on exact statements actually inspected.

value.rationale: The all-q pointwise square multiplicity at the first threshold is itself a worthwhile invariant, and neither the dimension cutoff nor an image-size estimate would substitute for it. For this finding as reviewed, however, both the support and the complete multiplicity function already have explicit exact catalogue coverage. Partitioning roots by the vanishing of two different input coordinates is a convenient calculation, but the frozen claim does not identify a distinct structural consequence or independently motivated invariant of those partial counts. Thus no substantive additional value beyond the same function in a different counting form is established.
residual_risks: This assesses incremental scientific content relative to the verified coverage, not historical credit or the usefulness of the invariant itself.
